title: Zebra-striped rows
description: Removes the hairline divider between arrival rows and instead alternates a subtle surface-2 fill on every other row, so rows are separated by contrast rather than a rule.

changes.intent: Drop the divider rule and give each row full-bleed horizontal padding so the alternating fill can extend edge-to-edge inside the card.
Alternate a subtle surface fill to visually separate consecutive rows without a rule.
